sources.scope: Required class-profile projection anchor for the shared source-binding validator.
Pinned FL-03/FL-04 daily consumption, ordinary food and water demands, endpoint settlement, and Expedition Strain trigger.
Pinned Expedition Strain recovery and the NEW Morale Rest endpoint; source-bound candidate behavior, not production promotion.

implementations.name: Schema62 TEST_ONLY daily provisioning and source-qualified Expedition Strain over the shared simulation
implemented: Bind the canonical day epoch, fixed roster, ordinary food/water demands, source references, registry version, and exactly two admitted Expedition-check IDs into the immutable TEST_ONLY content fingerprint.

Attribute daily quantities only from actual IntakeRecord intervals and consumed WorkLedger reservations, intersect freshness and half-open day boundaries, preserve settled days against later same-time intake, and settle every crossed endpoint once.
Persist causal daily settlements, per-lot/per-intake consumption evidence, and Expedition Strain gain history using the schema62 codec while preserving historical codec branches.

Project the adopted Strain effects through existing tactical attack/save, movement, permission, maximum-HP, death-save, ranged, reaction, and physical-work consumers without consuming RNG or rewriting authored initiative order.
Add current-source schema compatibility for the shared route-travel validator so the two explicitly registered route checks compose with daily settlement.
Candidate-revision, effective HP, post-encounter Dash scheduling, and modified death-save recovery now resolve through the existing shared authorities with save/replay regressions.
notImplemented: Production authority; non-fixed or mid-expedition roster changes; special diets, magical meals, needs modifiers, starvation remedies, Strain recovery, and day/watch profiles other than the approved epoch-zero daily profile.
Additional Expedition-check registrations, rest/recovery, offline progress, tactical intake, and historical back-assessment before the profile epoch.
Full production exploration, combat, content, AI, and management behavior beyond the procedures already represented by their bounded TEST_ONLY hosts.
Production Rest-site safety/eligibility and dynamic roster/calendar rules.
Emergency-specific interruption/debt opening, Long Rest benefits, Morale Rest, Haven care, Rest Debt recovery/removal and other Rest benefits.
The remainder of full exploration, combat, resource management and the complete game engine.
implementations.name: Schema63 TEST_ONLY Rest Watch and Rest Debt on the shared MGT-03 simulation
implemented: Persist typed cause references and per-actor same-command gain order in the shared Strain ledger; preserve schema62 wire layout.
Resolve prospective Rest Watch choices, missed outcomes, debt opening, due settlement, same-boundary ordering, reset and safe-rest clearance on RuleClock.
Resolve Rest-site admission from exact shared physical position; reject every outstanding ordinary traversal, including suspended partial movement.
Share the active-Rest command-admission rejection between query and execution, while preserving Rest controls and AdvanceClock.
Reuse WorkLedger, assignments and traversals to reject overlapping work and share time with companion activities.
Use explicit fingerprinted TEST_ONLY safe-site/eligibility facts; reject tactical entry while a Rest is active because no authoritative emergency event dispatcher exists.
Expose Rest commands through the common discovery/query authority and save all lifecycle records for deterministic replay.

implementations.name: Schema64 TEST_ONLY secure Rest recovery of one eligible Expedition Strain point
implemented: Schema64 appends causal provisioning-gate updates, completed-benefit records, pending exact-point offers, and append-only Strain removals after schema63 bytes; historical codec branches remain version-gated.

A closed, fully supported real-intake day can unblock only prior ordinary-removable daily-provisioning Strain points. Qualifying Rest completion is recorded independently of point eligibility; the one-beneficial-Rest-per-24-hours limit still applies while the provisioning block is active.

The exact point choice is persisted, query-discoverable, and freezes unrelated mutations until resolution. Resolution revalidates the original completed Rest, site, clock, debt, provisioning status, and active point; it removes one point without rewriting gain history or healing/reviving.

An accepted clock target remains in the existing ManufacturingAdvance continuation while choices are pending, and resumes once after the final choice; the legacy v1 fingerprint/profile preserves prior schema64 replay semantics. Snapshot and codec layout remain unchanged.

The connected scenario uses existing intake, WorkLedger, clock, daily settlement, Rest Debt, Rest interval, exploration, vessel handling, carrying projection, command receipt, codec, save/restore and deterministic replay authorities.
notImplemented: Only the fixed TEST_ONLY hero/companion profile, canonical epoch-zero daily provisioning, and explicitly fingerprinted secure Rest sites are covered. Production qualification, dynamic rosters/sites, generalized Rest schedules and non-daily Strain recovery are unsupported.
No additional Strain recovery profile or healing/rest reward is implied; this increment does not implement production Strain recovery or other Rest benefits.

Only explicit base fixture vessels bridge to VesselHandling while no PortableEquipment ledger is selected. Actual linked portable items continue through UsePortableEquipmentHandling; generalized portable integration is outside this increment.
Unity import/editor compilation, scenes, Play Mode, player build, and presentation are not run; gameplay integration remains deferred.

implementations.name: Schema65 TEST_ONLY Morale Rest over the shared clock, work, Strain history and persistence
implemented: Record voluntary four-hour safe recreation against RuleClock and reject incompatible participant activity while allowing other actors.
Settle shared provisioning/Rest Debt boundaries before Morale eligibility; persist independent Morale completion allowance and reuse exact-point recovery choice/provenance.
Append schema65 typed records and codec fields while preserving schema64 bytes and legacy behavior.
Retain active interval, interruption, pending choice, accepted clock continuation, duplicate receipts and deterministic save/replay.
notImplemented: Production Morale Rest authority; general recreation activities or dynamic site safety.
Emergency interruption dispatch beyond represented incapacity; tactical entry remains gated.
Haven care and recovery of other Strain sources.
Unity gameplay integration and full-engine completion.
